title: India’s medical tourism – level 1
paragraphs: India is a famous place for medical tourism. Many sick people travel to India every year. The country has very good private hospitals and clever doctors.

The treatments are much cheaper than in Western countries. Patients do not wait long for operations. Many patients come from Africa and Asia. Today, other countries like Thailand and Turkey also want more patients from different countries.
To stay ahead, Indian companies are using new technology and AI to help doctors. India wants to show that its healthcare is modern, safe, and high quality, not only cheap.

words.d: when people travel to another country to undergo operations
a business that a person or business runs, not a government
medical care which a patient gets
